limitations: One H100, Qwen3-0.6B, local TCP Store, synthetic draft weights, Catalog test double.
Serving uses Torch teacher top-k, direct KV/teacher D2H, explicit post-warmup GC freeze and seeded producer RNG.
One Torch-then-HiCache off/on/off serving pair does not establish significance or production SLO acceptance.
Primitive probe's repeated source-overwrite check is strong only in its first case; complete-export and CUDA tests use fresh sources.
v1/v2 FP16 copy fixtures had a BF16 codec label; v3 fixes the label and validates the KV spec before testing. Production code is identical.
Mapped Host kernel stores are not CUDA memcpy events. Enqueued byte counters are not completed traffic or wire bytes.
Broader models/topologies, distributed RDMA with this backend, production Catalog/consumer and trained-draft quality are not certified.

initial_audit_failure.reason: The first auditor assumed exactly prompt+response-1 exported KV rows. Overlap exports terminal lookahead: Torch trace independently measures the same 25190400 prefill and 6488064 decode bytes as HiCache counters.
